summary: Ground transponder testing near Yeovil from the surface to 3,100 feet, 6am to 5.30pm, may cause false aircraft indications within 5 miles.
text:
GROUND TRANSPONDER TESTING. MODE S TEST TRANSPONDER LOCATED AT:
505616N 0023914W (YEOVIL). POSSIBLE FALSE ACFT INDICATIONS MAY OCCUR 
WI 5NM RADIUS. MAX HGT 2500FT AGL. MAY INDICATE A SPEED OF 300KTS. 
DIRECT OVERFLIGHT BELOW 100FT SHOULD BE AVOIDED. FOR INFO MONITOR 
CH130.805 OR CTC 07355 602575. AR-2026-10959/01.
